/* Спільні стилі меню продавця. */ .vendor-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 20px; overflow: hidden; } .vendor-sidebar-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-4); } .vendor-avatar { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--green-light); color: var(--green-dark); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; } .vendor-sidebar-identity { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .vendor-sidebar-identity strong { color: var(--dark); font-size: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .vendor-sidebar-identity span { color: var(--gray-2); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; } .vendor-menu { padding: 8px 0 12px; } .vendor-nav-label { padding: 14px 20px 6px; color: var(--gray-3); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .vendor-nav { list-style: none; } .vendor-nav li a { border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; margin-right: 12px; } .vendor-nav li a:hover, .vendor-nav li a.active { background: var(--green-light); color: var(--green); border-left-color: var(--green); } .vendor-nav li a.active { font-weight: 800; } .vendor-nav svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; color: currentColor; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .vendor-sidebar { position: static; } .vendor-menu { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 4px; } .vendor-nav-label { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .vendor-nav { display: contents; } .vendor-nav li a { margin-right: 0; border-radius: 8px; margin: 2px 8px; } }
